page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; list of chapter headings (XI–XIV) in hanging indent; ornamental rule; centred heading "II." and title "INDEX LOCORUM SCRIPTURÆ VINDICATORUM, EXPLICATORUM, & illustratorum."; subheading "GENESIS."; a two-part table of Cap./Verf./Pag. columns separated by a vertical rule; catchword "Cap." at lower right.

main_text.l: XI. De Variis Lectionibus, ex Vulgata Translatione Latina.
XII. De Variis Lectionibus, quæ deprehendi possunt ex Judæorum scriptis, Talmude, Rabboth, Masora, & Rabbinorum Commentariis.
XIII. De Variis Lectionibus Hebraicis, deprehendendis & eruendis ex Conjectura, sine vel Codicum, vel Authorum & Interpretum authoritate.
XIV. De Ultima Critica hujus Sacræ Confirmatione & Illustratione, ex simili Variarum Lectionum, in omni genere antiquorum Librorum, Observatione.

page.notes: The numerals in the table are printed in the old style (e.g. "ɔ" forms for 5, "ı" for 1); transcribed as their Arabic values. Heading "II." is a section number. Ornamental rule between the chapter list and the section heading is not text. Catchword "Cap." is at lower right and is the first word of the next page's table. Some letters in the running head and title are faint.
